from pathlib import Path
import json,re
event="1791200100-26923ff8e33b"
base=Path.home()/".local/share/prediction-chat-bridge"
for d in ("sent","inflight","outbox"):
    p=base/d/f"{event}.json"
    if p.is_file():
        obj=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8",errors="replace"))
        msg=str(obj.get("message") or "")
        m=re.search(r'DIRTY_DECISION=(\{.*\})\s*$',msg,re.M)
        if not m:
            print("DIRTY_DECISION_READ=MISSING",flush=True)
            raise SystemExit(2)
        data=json.loads(m.group(1))
        print("DIRTY_DECISION_READ="+json.dumps(data,separators=(",",":"),sort_keys=True),flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(0)
print("DIRTY_DECISION_READ=EVENT_MISSING",flush=True)
raise SystemExit(2)
